summary: Mid-stage SaaS KB vendor evaluating Redwood hosted API for high-QPS knowledge base RAG. Looking to serve product support chat + embedded doc search with a lightweight cross-encoder rerank step. Priorities: sub-150ms median latency for retrieval+rerank, predictable cost per query at scale, and simple hosted onboarding (no infra).
requirements_summary: Indexing scale: ~400k-750k documents (KB articles + transcripts); incremental daily delta ~2k docs
QPS: peak 250-400 qps for search endpoint (support hours) with spiky bursts
Latency targets: median end-to-end (embedding retrieval + rerank) <=120-150ms; p99 budget <=400ms
Cost sensitivity: target blended cost per query <= $0.003 (including embed + rerank + model tokens)
Model preferences: dense embeddings (128-1536d), prefer high-quality open embeddings or Redwood-verified hosted models; cross-encoder reranker for top-10 candidates
Routing/fallback: prefer automatic fallback to lower-cost embedding model during sustained spikes; caching of top queries
Security/compliance: SSO/SAML, audit logs, customer-managed KMS preferred
Integration: ingestion via S3/HTTP + incremental webhook updates; vector store compatibility with Pinecone/Milvus/OpenSearch
SLA expectations: 99.9% availability during business hours; predictable throughput for peak windows
